title: Open Images V7
license: Per-image Creative Commons license and attribution metadata
estimated_size: large-scale; select classes and splits before intake
summary: Broad visual vocabulary suitable for detection and mask evaluation pilots.
risk_notes: Rights and attribution must be evaluated per image; do not bulk mirror before an image-level license filter is implemented.

title: COCO 2017
license: Image-level licenses; see COCO terms and image metadata
summary: Core benchmark for common-object detection and segmentation conversion tests.
risk_notes: Use the official annotations but validate image-level rights and downstream commercial scope before copying any split.

title: LVIS v1
license: Annotations under LVIS terms; underlying COCO image rights remain image-level
summary: Long-tail classes complement COCO when benchmark depth matters.
risk_notes: Requires a joint review of LVIS annotation terms and the underlying COCO image licenses.

title: TACO: Trash Annotations in Context
license: CC BY 4.0
estimated_size: about 1,500 images; validate current release manifest
summary: Useful first intake for urban cleanliness and water-edge litter pilots.
risk_notes: Retain attribution and inspect source images for identifiable people, plates or local restrictions before distribution.

title: Road Traversing Knowledge
license: CC BY 4.0
summary: Road-centric segmentation samples for road inspection and promptable mask evaluation.
risk_notes: Verify the release revision, labels and any visible vehicle or address data before importing.

title: Road Damage Dataset 2022
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 with source-specific street imagery terms
estimated_size: 47,000+ images; intake by country and source
summary: Large road-damage benchmark covering multiple countries and road conditions.
risk_notes: Some imagery sources impose additional restrictions; keep country/source provenance and do not assume uniform commercial rights.

title: DeepWeeds
license: CC BY 4.0
summary: Agricultural weed dataset valuable for classification baselines and discovery.
risk_notes: It is not a detection or mask dataset; use only after a task-specific annotation plan is approved.

title: Global Wheat Detection
license: CC BY 4.0; verify the current competition terms
summary: Focused field imagery for crop-counting and small-object detection pilots.
risk_notes: Kaggle acceptance and any current competition terms must be recorded before retrieval.

title: D-Fire
license: Research-use terms; review upstream license
summary: Smoke and fire benchmark suitable for offline R&D evaluation only.
risk_notes: Do not place in a commercial intake batch until the provider grants suitable rights.

title: SH17 Safety Helmet Dataset
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
summary: PPE benchmark for non-commercial baseline comparison.
risk_notes: Non-commercial license excludes marketplace and production reuse without a separate authorization.

title: BDD100K
license: Academic and research dataset terms
summary: Rich driving-scene benchmark for internal research comparisons.
risk_notes: Requires acceptance of the provider terms and should remain segregated from commercial inventory.

title: Mapillary Vistas
license: Mapillary dataset license and terms
summary: Street-scene segmentation candidate for road and municipal perception research.
risk_notes: Review current Mapillary terms, geographic privacy rules and redistribution restrictions before retrieval.

title: Cityscapes
license: Cityscapes non-commercial dataset license
summary: High-quality urban segmentation benchmark for research evaluation.
risk_notes: Registration and non-commercial constraints preclude automatic production intake.

title: Objects365 V2
license: Research dataset terms; verify current release license
summary: Large-scale detection research candidate, not a first storage batch.
risk_notes: Storage cost, rights and source-image provenance require a dedicated approval before any subset download.

title: Segment Anything 1 Billion Masks
license: SA-1B Research License
summary: Foundational mask corpus for research planning, not a near-term storage target.
risk_notes: Research-only terms and storage footprint require explicit legal and infrastructure approval.

title: Segment Anything Video Dataset
license: Research dataset license; review current terms
summary: Video-mask research candidate relevant to future streaming segmentation workflows.
risk_notes: Not an automatic YOLO training source; model and dataset terms must be reviewed separately.

title: ADE20K
license: Dataset terms; verify the current release license
summary: Scene-parsing benchmark for mask and taxonomy research.
risk_notes: Do not infer commercial rights from public availability; complete a license review first.

title: PASCAL VOC 2012
license: PASCAL VOC terms; inspect image sources
summary: Compact benchmark for parser and conversion smoke tests.
risk_notes: Use only after image-source and downstream-use conditions are reviewed.

title: VisDrone
license: Research dataset terms; verify current release license
summary: Aerial small-object detection reference for drone and infrastructure research.
risk_notes: Separate video/privacy review is required before any copy into platform storage.

title: DOTA
license: Research-use dataset terms
summary: Oriented-box benchmark useful for later geospatial perception support.
risk_notes: Requires oriented-box conversion and a separate rights assessment for aerial imagery.

title: xView
license: xView terms and imagery license
summary: Satellite detection benchmark for future land and infrastructure analysis.
risk_notes: Registration, imagery-use restrictions and possible export controls require review before retrieval.

title: TreeSatAI
license: Check repository and upstream geospatial data licenses
summary: Forestry discovery candidate, useful for landscape classification rather than detection.
risk_notes: Not a direct detection or segmentation import; verify individual source licenses and geospatial constraints.
